subject: Request: temporary response-tier carveout for migration weekend (P1/P2 coverage)
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@nimblepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: platform+redwood@nimblepay.com
Date: 2028-05-22 09:12 PDT
Subject: Request: temporary response-tier carveout for migration weekend (P1/P2 coverage)

Hi Soojin,

We're rolling a planned database migration and region routing change for NimblePay next weekend (APAC primary: Singapore) and expect elevated alert noise in the overnight window (00:00–06:00 SGT, Fri–Sun). The migration team anticipates a handful of transient throttles and failover events that will generate P1/P2 alerts tied to regional routing.

Can Redwood provide a temporary response-tier carveout for this migration window to avoid automatic SLA credits and to allow us to operate a heavier monitoring posture without triggering penalties? Specifically, we're asking for: 
- A 2-week carveout window starting 2028-05-24 through 2028-06-06 covering APAC region only
- P2 response adjusted from 4 hours -> 8 hours for non-service-impacting routing alarms during the nightly migration window (00:00–06:00 SGT)
- Maintain P1 response and on-call activation requirement (we will escalate any confirmed customer-impacting sessions)

I've attached the migration timeline and a short runbook. We'll provide a dedicated migration Slack channel and a rota for our SREs to be on-call.

Can you confirm whether Redwood needs any specific fallback routing or permanent config changes to support this, and what approval is required on your end?

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Reliability
NimblePay
Attachment: migration-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: runbook-migration.txt (text)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: temporary response-tier carveout for migration weekend (P1/P2 coverage)

Thanks Elena — got the timeline and runbook. +1 on coordinating; this is the right way to handle predictable migration-induced noise. A few quick checks from our side before we route approval: 

- Confirmed scope: APAC region only (SG/JP), no changes to EU/US SLA scopes.
- Carveout window: 2028-05-24 through 2028-06-06.
- P2 behavior: we can tentatively shift P2 "non-service-impacting" response to 8 hours for the nightly window, but we need an explicit definition from NimblePay of what counts as "non-service-impacting" (e.g., metric thresholds, affected customers).
- P1 remains unchanged: immediate on-call activation and escalation path. Any incident where end-user experience is degraded must follow the P1 playbook.

Ben / Karthik — can you folks review operational risks and confirm if Redwood can accept this carveout under the conditions above? If approved, I'll draft a short SLO addendum and a 2-week credit waiver that we can attach to the customer's account.

Elena — can you also share the Slack channel name and your SRE rotation for the nights? We'll need primary and secondary contacts for each migration night.

Cheers,
--
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22 11:15 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: temporary response-tier carveout for migration weekend (P1/P2 coverage)

+1 from me with conditions:
- Approve the 2-week APAC-only carveout as proposed, provided NimblePay publishes the exact signal thresholds that will be considered "non-service-impacting" within 12 hours. We cannot broadly waive P2 without objective gating.
- Require that Redwood maintain P1 activation and that NimblePay designate a single Incident Commander per migration night (name + cell).
- We will provide a one-time, pro-rated credit cap for any automated SLA credits that would otherwise apply during the carveout window (I'm proposing a $7,500 cap). This is approval-conditional on legal signing a short addendum (I'll loop legal once Soojin drafts it).

Karthik, given routing/fallback may be touched, do you foresee any timing constraints for ops to enable manual fallback or do we need to spin a dedicated canary pool?

Ben
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-credit-terms.txt (text)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22 13:42 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: temporary response-tier carveout for migration weekend (P1/P2 coverage)

Thanks — technical note on fallbacks:
- We can avoid production-wide routing changes by enabling a regional canary pool for NimblePay traffic for the nightly window. That gives us manual control to drain/shift traffic without touching global routing. Canary pool spin-up is ~45 minutes if we pre-allocate the GPUs; lead time to guarantee capacity is 48 hours.
- For any P1 we will follow our standard on-call path. For the migration nights I recommend Redwood staff an additional secondary pager for the 00:00–06:00 SGT window (two engineers: primary + secondary) to ensure response SLAs. We can staff this out of the Dedicated on-call pool; I'll coordinate schedules.
- I'll prepare a short runbook for the canary pool activation and an automated play that lists exact metric thresholds (5xx rate > 1% sustained for 5 min, request latency P95 > 1500ms) that we'll treat as customer-impacting. Please confirm if these thresholds map to NimblePay's expectations.

Lauren — can you please prepare the CS communication draft to customers and the internal status post template?

Karthik
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: canary-pool-runbook.md (text)
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@nimblepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: platform+redwood@nimblepay.com
Date: 2028-05-24 17:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: temporary response-tier carveout for migration weekend (P1/P2 coverage)

Thanks everyone — this plan looks good and we accept the conditions. Responses below: 
- Scope confirmed: APAC only.
- Non-service-impacting definition: the attached doc (slo-carveout-req.pdf) includes our proposed thresholds and customer-impact definition. We agree to the metric gating you proposed (5xx >1% sustained for 5m or P95 latency >1500ms) and will flag anything we think is customer-impacting.
- Slack channel: #nimblepay-migration-redwood (we'll invite Ben and Karthik).
- SRE rota: Primary: Ajay Rao (+65 9123 4456); Secondary: Mei Tan (+65 9876 2211).

I've signed the short addendum via DocuSign; the signed copy is attached. We'll expect Redwood to spin the canary pool by 2028-05-23 11:00 SGT and to staff the additional pager for the three migration nights.

Elena Ortiz
Head of Platform Reliability
NimblePay
Attachment: slo-carveout-req.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: signed-carveout-docusign.pdf (pdf)
